The Bluejays were led by 10th-year head coach [[Greg McDermott]] and played their home games at the [[CHI Health Center Omaha]] in [[Omaha, Nebraska]], as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 24–7, 13–5 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to earn share of the Big East regular season championship, and the No. 1 seed in the conference tournament. The [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] and all other postseason tournaments including the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] were canceled shortly after the regular season ended due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. The cancellations effectively ended the Bluejays' season. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Bluejays]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 20–15, 9–9 in [[2018–19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a four-way tie for third place.
